## Change

Describe the problem and the behavior changed.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests cover passing and fail-closed paths where relevant.
- [ ] `make gate` passes.
- [ ] Public API, CLI, schema, and documentation changes are recorded.
- [ ] Fixtures and examples are synthetic.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private material, or authorship trailers are included.

## Compatibility and security

Describe compatibility impact, resource bounds, and any threat-model change.
